body.message:
Thank you for the detailed feedback, and I'm sorry the apartment didn't meet your expectations on arrival.

We did offer to send our housekeeping team to address the cleaning issues, but you've asked us not to send anyone during your stay. Without access, we're unable to fix anything on our end while you're there.

If you change your mind, we can send the team any time — just let us know a convenient time. Thank you for your understanding
